integrity: The proof separates the analytic incomplete-Gamma transition expansion from the new localization and optimization argument. Published numerical minimizers are used only as a stress test, not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is asymptotic as \(\kappa\downarrow1\) from above and does not supply a uniform nonasymptotic error constant.
No uniqueness claim is made for the global minimizer at each fixed \(\kappa>1\).
An unindexed or differently phrased equivalent critical-scaling result remains a residual literature risk.
title: Critical scaling at the Gamma mean phase transition
